memories.content: Keep the total, major cost categories, and one-line estimate basis in the main text so the resource argument can be understood without leaving the proposal.
Place each major cost beside the activity or deliverable it enables in the main text.
State the quantity and unit-rate basis for each major cost in the same paragraph that requests it.
Readers may question a proposed priority when its cost cannot be checked on the same page as the claimed benefit.
Update the cost sentence whenever the related activity changes so the narrative and requested amount cannot drift apart.
Accept a denser main-text paragraph when the estimate basis is essential to deciding whether the request is proportionate.
The user tends to revise the work plan but forget a detached budget table unless the key amount is repeated beside the activity.
Specify field and user data sources and analysis procedures corresponding to all HCI research questions.
In preregistered studies, clarify the criteria for judging plan changes.
In preregistered studies, clarify the location for recording plan changes.
Use a justified minimum-to-maximum target range when confirmations can change, and tie the minimum and maximum to different workload and budget cases.
Specify the observation records, system logs, or interview tools used to collect each type of field and user data.
Specify whether each type of field and user data will be collected before, during, or after deployment.
Readers cannot assess a target range unless both bounds have a stated consequence for schedule, workload, or cost.
In field deployments, network and service instability exist as independent causes of task failure alongside design choices.
If a safety signal occurs in the field system, existing institutional safety procedures take precedence over the research schedule and data collection plan.
Reviewers judge answerability by tracing the path from each research question to its data sources and analysis procedures.
The user authoring this proposal tends to present implemented feature lists directly as design contributions.
Define what can still be completed at the minimum target instead of treating every number inside the range as operationally identical.
Use a bounded range to absorb expected confirmation changes without pretending that one early estimate is guaranteed.
Show how session count and facilitator time change at the minimum and maximum bounds.
Define the additional workload or deliverable enabled at the maximum target so the upper bound is not an arbitrary cushion.
A bounded range preserves uncertainty honestly but makes the final workload and budget less certain than one fixed target.

analysis.overview: Both frames strengthen proposal auditability by connecting resource claims to operational consequences. The reference additionally emphasizes keeping cost narratives synchronized with activities, while the compared frame adds research-method traceability, bounded-target uncertainty, change documentation, field risks, safety precedence, and an authoring tendency.

relations.reason: The reference specifies prominent, activity-linked cost details, while the compared frame specifies operationally differentiated resource bounds; these complementary requirements jointly make proportionality and feasibility assessable.
relations.summary: Resource requests should expose their estimate basis and connect requested amounts or bounds to the activities, workload, deliverables, and consequences they enable.

relations.reason: The reference identifies both the recurring risk of overlooking a detached budget and the corresponding update policy; the compared frame does not address narrative-budget drift.
relations.summary: Cost information should remain beside and synchronized with the activity narrative as the work plan changes.

relations.reason: These compared-side memories divide one methodological answerability requirement into its source, instrument, timing, analysis, and reviewer-traceability components; the reference contains no corresponding research-method claim.
relations.summary: Each HCI research question should trace to specified data sources, collection instruments, collection timing, and analysis procedures.

relations.reason: The compared frame supplies two complementary parts of one preregistration change-control requirement, which is absent from the reference.
relations.summary: Preregistered studies should define both the criteria for judging plan changes and where those changes are recorded.

relations.reason: The compared frame states the range strategy and its uncertainty tradeoff as one underlying claim; the reference discusses estimate transparency but not how to represent confirmation uncertainty.
relations.summary: Expected confirmation changes should be represented with a bounded target range while acknowledging that the range leaves final workload and budget less certain.

relations.reason: This compared-side causal distinction is independently useful and has no counterpart in the reference.
relations.summary: Field-deployment task failures may arise independently from network or service instability rather than from design choices.

relations.reason: This compared-side safety-governance rule is independently useful and absent from the reference.
relations.summary: A field-system safety signal makes existing institutional safety procedures take precedence over research scheduling and data collection.

relations.reason: This compared-side authoring tendency is independent of the resource and methodology policies and has no reference-side counterpart.
relations.summary: The proposal author tends to present implemented feature lists directly as design contributions.

reports.both: Both require resource requests to be checkable through explicit estimate details and links between amounts, workload, deliverables, and practical consequences.
reports.compared_only: The compared frame alone covers research-question traceability, preregistered change records, bounded-target uncertainty, infrastructure failures, safety precedence, and a tendency to mistake feature lists for design contributions.
reports.reference_only: The reference alone addresses preventing drift between revised activities and detached budget information.
